main_text.l: si ab eâdem causa perfequenda abstineamus, ex
quo Iehouam Deum nostrum & Ecclesiam Do-
minum Iehouæ Dei nostri per Scripturas sacras
didicimus? Quapropter (ut ait Apostolus)
expergiscamur qui dormimus, & surgamus
à mortuis, & illucescet nobis Christus. Intuea-
mur semper in illam essentiam distinam [?], quæ
principium est omnis boni, tum natura
communi, tum gratia erga nos singulariter. Intueamur
in Patrem illum omnipotentem, qui nos dedit
filio in Ecclesiam colligendos: Intueamur in fi-
dei ducem ac perfectorem Iesum, qui pro gau-
dio sibi propositò pertulit crucem, & ad dex-
tram throni Dei consedit, quò nos euehæret [?]:
Intueamur in Spiritu illum patris & filij habi-
tantem in nobis, & testante spiritui nostro nos
esse filios Dei, & templa sancta Domino: Intuea-
mur in Ecclesiam, in quam velut templum le-
ctissimum Deus nos convocat, ut per eam ad se
contendamus virtute æterni spiritus viuentis in
nobis. hæ causæ nos ita moverint, ut cæteras
causas dimoveant ex mentibus nostris, & ra-
piant ad sanctissimum illud studium, cuius hic
Propheta meminit, & seipsum exhibet typum
in pietate & sanctimonia ad hæc officia præ-tarum.
Quid ergo est officij, quod Propheta hoc lo-
co prædicat? Quæram [?], inquit, sive procurabe quod
bonum est tibi, ô Ierusalem, vel domus Iehouæ.

page.notes: Printed text is set in a long-s face; long s has been read as s throughout. Doubtful readings: "distinam" (printed distinam, may be a damaged or abbreviated word), "euehæret" (printed euehçret, last letters unclear), "Quæram" (printed Quáram, accent unclear), "procurabe" (printed as shown, may be procurabo). The line "tarum." after "præ-" is the end of the word split across lines; the full word is unclear. A stray mark of small dashes stands below the "tarum." line and is not text. The paragraph beginning "Quid ergo" is indented with a leading mark that is not printed text. The margin notes "Ephes. 5." and "Hebr. 12." are in the left margin.
